## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow sector wins (Energy, Industrials, Materials) with Technology and Financials weak, and a MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (multiple names with 1W ≠ 1M) — keep stance neutral.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: BA (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +2.74%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: DOW (1W: +5.25% | 1M: +1.72%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: -3.35% | 1M: +11.87%) CORRECTION.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed/soft: JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary under pressure: TSLA (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: +5.47% | 1M: -2.54%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND; NKE (1W: +5.47% | 1M: -2.54%) RECOVERY; COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — favors Value/Cyclical style.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: MCD (1W: -3.21% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION; GILD (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%) BELOW TREND; NEM (1W: -3.35% | 1M: +11.87%) CORRECTION; NOW (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -10.57%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech/Software and some Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND; NKE (1W: +5.47% | 1M: -2.54%) RECOVERY; COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (JPM, V, MA, TSLA) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to soft; NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 6/19 positive — internal rotation with meaningful divergence.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are transitional: JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.15%) CORRECTION. Financials breadth: 7/20 positive — style tilt toward cyclicals but short-term caution.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed but resilient names showing strength: UNH (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +3.27%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare breadth: 9/15 positive — defensive elements present but not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclical/value exposure: emphasize Energy (SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND) and select Industrials (BA (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +2.74%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging Tech (AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical, but monitor the MAJOR DIVERGENCE for potential trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND — news +60 confirms; OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND — momentum; UNH (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%) ABOVE TREND — defensive strength.  
BEARISH: TSLA (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION — sharp 1W drop; NOW (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -10.57%) BELOW TREND — continued weakness; INTU (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND with negative sentiment (-50).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: 7/8 positive) — clear leadership; Industrials (Breadth: 10/13 positive) — follow-through possible.  
BEARISH: Technology (Breadth: 6/19 positive) — watch for further dispersion; Financials (Breadth: 7/20 positive) — mixed signals and short-term softness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) ABOVE TREND — watch breakout above recent highs for continuation. AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND — failure to regain 1M support would deepen weakness. JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) CORRECTION — reclaiming 1W momentum would signal stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTC (+60): Intel (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY — strategic Nvidia investment headline aligns with heavy 1W inflow (sentiment confirming price). SLB (+60): SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND — Aramco contract news confirmed by strong price action. PFE (+45): PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND — analyst support and price modestly confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (-50): INTU (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND — cautious FY guidance and price weakness align. MS (-45): MS (1W: -? | 1M: +?) CORRECTION — regulatory concerns flagged; monitor weekly follow-through (use CORRECTION label only if 1W negative & 1M positive). UNP (-40): UNP (1W: -? | 1M: +?) CORRECTION — merger/regulatory headlines warrant watching for operational impact. (Note: where exact 1W/1M for some sentiment names are not in top list, treat as sector-level watch; maintain labels for cited SP100 names.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (multiple CORRECTION/RECOVERY signals) and mixed tech/financial internals despite cyclical leadership.
